title: Flaco López stands out among Palmeiras' assist providers in the Brasileirão
seoTitle: Flaco López Shines as Palmeiras' Top Playmaker
subtitle: The midfielder ranks second in the club's assist leaderboard for 2026
excerpt: Flaco López has four assists in 21 matches for Palmeiras, ranking second on the team's assist list in the 2026 Brasileirão.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Flaco López's name is back in the sports headlines after the player recorded four assists over 21 matches in the 2026 Campeonato Brasileiro. This performance places him second in Palmeiras' internal playmaker ranking, generating great interest among fans.

Flaco López in Palmeiras' assist ranking

According to a survey by Terra, the midfielder is right behind Andreas Pereira, who leads the list with ten goal passes. López, with four assists, occupies the second position among Verdão players in the Brasileirão.

Comparison with other club players

The ranking also includes Joaquín Piquerez, with four assists in 11 matches, and Allan, who distributed three passes in 21 games. Jhon Arias rounds out the Top 5 with three assists in 19 matches, while Ramón Sosa has two in 19 games. The remaining names—Felipe Anderson, Maurício, Murilo, and Marlon Freitas—registered one assist each.

Importance of assists for Palmeiras

In a schedule recognized as one of the toughest in the world, the ability to create goalscoring opportunities is essential for the team's success. Flaco López's presence among the top playmakers highlights the depth of the alviverde squad in offensive buildup.

Andreas Pereira as a benchmark of production

The same survey highlights Andreas Pereira as Palmeiras' absolute assist leader, with ten goal passes in 23 matches. According to Jogada 10, the Portuguese player also has four goals and has already participated in 44 matches for the club in 2026, solidifying himself as one of Abel Ferreira's main providers.

Outlook for the rest of the season

With Flaco López maintaining second place in the internal ranking, expectations are that he will continue contributing to Palmeiras' offensive plays throughout the remainder of the championship. His performance reinforces the importance of having multiple creative options in the midfield.

With information from Terra, Jogada 10.
